title: Let {product} hear you when you hold to talk
goal: Turn on the Microphone for {product} (only used while you hold the talk keys)

steps.say: Open System Settings from the Apple menu.
steps.find: the Apple menu at the top left of the screen

steps.say: Choose Privacy & Security in the list on the left.
Turn on the switch next to {product}.

instead.say: If {product} is not in the list, press the plus button under the list and pick {product} from Applications.
instead.find: the plus button under the list
